messages:
maya: Quick idea — micro LAN this Friday in the mezzanine? projector + small TV. low-key, 6 people max. who’s in? :joystick: :popcorn:

devin: I’m in if there’s room for a Steam PC. can bring Ethernet switch. :thumbsup:

sam: I can bring my Switch + dock and Smash. also have spare joycons. :smile:

jen: I’ll bring snacks. any dietary restrictions? :cookie: :vegan_heart:

chris: Count me in for Rocket League or Smash. what time? 6pm sound ok?

maya: 6pm works. planning to keep it casual — quick bracket or freeplay depending on turnout. also projector has flaky HDMI so bring adapters.

devin: FYI, ethernet ports in mezz have been flaky lately. I’ll bring a small unmanaged switch and an extra cable.

maya: Awesome — can people drop a one-line RSVP here with what they’ll bring? I’ll paste into calendar.

sam: sam - Switch + dock + joycons

devin: devin - Steam PC + switch + extra cable

jen: jen - snacks (vegan and regular)

chris: chris - controller + Rocket League

alex: alex - maybe? bring spare monitor? (tbd)

maya: cool list. I’ll reserve the mezz and add to shared calendar. tagging infra in case the mezz network needs a quick check: @eng-infra

rsvp-bot: Event created: "Mezzanine Micro LAN" on Fri 18:00. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/2134567890

devin: tiny note — if anyone needs to run Discord voice, consider turning off high-res streaming to save bandwidth.

jen: pumped. who’s bringing HDMI -> USB-C adapter? we might need one for the projector.

sam: I’ve got one, will bring as backup. :white_check_mark:

maya: Perfect. see y’all Friday! :party_popper:
